SELECT a.id AS id, a.student_id AS studentId, u.username AS studentUsername, u.real_name AS studentRealName, u.nickname AS studentNickname, a.text_id AS textId, t.title AS textTitle, a.session_id AS sessionId, a.assignment_id AS assignmentId, a.total_questions AS totalQuestions, a.correct_count AS correctCount, a.score AS score, a.total_time_seconds AS totalTimeSeconds, a.submitted_time AS submittedTime, a.created_time AS createdTime FROM student_ai_quiz_attempts a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.student_id LEFT JOIN texts t ON t.id = a.text_id
ORDER BY a.submitted_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
